div.div: Bus order on both buses: N1 (Pi) at one end, N2 in the middle, N3 at the other end. Every module is an XIAO CAN board (MCP2515 + SN65HVD230, 16 MHz crystal, 3.3 V). Each CANH/CANL tap goes through its own jumper wire = the R4.8 fault-injection point. Bus breadboard probe rows A_H, A_L, B_H, B_L. Common GND between Pi, both Nucleos and the bus breadboard.

SPI0 (kernel mcp251x, 16 MHz osc)

div.div: Notes. (1) Module pin D9 is MISO and D10 is MOSI on these boards (the handout figure has them swapped). (2) Termination uses the P1 pad on N1's and N3's modules; P1 sits on the module side of the jumper, so pulling an end node's jumper also removes that bus end's terminator (R4.3 wants it on the bus side; known trade-off, discrete 120 Ω on the rail ends would fix it). (3) CANH–CANL measured powered off: bus A 58 Ω. (4) Bus levels (photos 8–9): idle ≈ 2.2 V both lines, dominant differential 2.07 V (A) / 1.97 V (B).
